title: EnsembleReviewResult
description: Strict schema for a single reviewer's output in the multi-model ensemble review pipeline.

reviewer.description: Review lens identifier. Standard lenses: security, correctness, readability_performance, spec_contract. Custom lenses (e.g. for a 5th Gemini/Grok reviewer) are allowed.

severity.description: critical=bug/security/regulatory risk if shipped. warning=fix before merge. suggestion=nice to have.

confidence.description: high=directly observed in diff/audit. medium=strong inference. low=possible but uncertain.

line.description: Line number in the file, or null if not applicable.

rationale.description: Why this matters. Include concrete evidence.

observed_or_inferred.description: Whether this finding is directly observed in the diff, observed in the runtime audit, or inferred from context.

blocking.description: True if this finding should block merge.

repro_command.description: Optional command to reproduce or verify the issue.

contract_reference.description: Optional path to the spec, manifest, or artifact this finding relates to.
